# loaders.gl

> Framework-independent loaders for visualization, 3D graphics and geospatial formats.


## docs

Load, scan, transform, and write the data formats used by modern web applications.

- [Big data loading for the web.](https://loaders.gl/next/docs.md): Load, scan, transform, and write the data formats used by modern web applications.

### developer-guide


#### get-started

Install the core package, choose a loader, and load your first file.

- [Get started with loaders.gl](https://loaders.gl/next/docs/developer-guide/get-started.md): Install the core package, choose a loader, and load your first file.

- [Query feature layers and tables](https://loaders.gl/next/docs/developer-guide/arcgis/feature-layers.md): Retrieve complete bounded queries, stream pages, inspect completeness, and retain nonspatial records.
- [Bring your ArcGIS content](https://loaders.gl/next/docs/developer-guide/arcgis/items.md): Resolve service-backed portal items, preserve metadata, and choose a layer for visualization.
- [Troubleshoot an ArcGIS integration](https://loaders.gl/next/docs/developer-guide/arcgis/troubleshooting.md): Diagnose incomplete data, authentication errors, coordinate problems and unsupported operations.

#### concepts

- [Process batches with ordinary JavaScript.](https://loaders.gl/next/docs/developer-guide/concepts/async-iterators.md): Use JavaScript async iterators as the portable interface for streaming loaders and writers.
- [Make the bytes do the work.](https://loaders.gl/next/docs/developer-guide/concepts/binary-data.md): Move typed bytes efficiently between files, workers, loaders, and renderers.
- [Measure bytes, copies, and boundaries.](https://loaders.gl/next/docs/developer-guide/concepts/javascript-and-wasm-performance.md): Compare complete data-loading pipelines instead of judging performance by decoder language alone.
- [Use the platform boundary loaders.gl already understands.](https://loaders.gl/next/docs/developer-guide/concepts/javascript-apis.md): Use portable browser and Node.js APIs for loading, writing, binary data, and images.
- [Start processing before the file is complete.](https://loaders.gl/next/docs/developer-guide/concepts/streaming.md): Understand incremental loading, batched updates, and async data flows in loaders.gl.
- [Describe the result once. Let the source optimize it.](https://loaders.gl/next/docs/developer-guide/concepts/table-scan-architecture.md): Use one small query contract across in-memory tables, files, cloud datasets, and backend services.
- [Keep the interface responsive while data is decoded.](https://loaders.gl/next/docs/developer-guide/concepts/worker-threads.md): Move expensive parsing off the browser main thread while keeping data transfer explicit.

#### converters

- [Change representation without hard-coding every route.](https://loaders.gl/next/docs/developer-guide/converters/dispatcher.md): Route compatible table and geometry values through the shortest registered conversion path.
- [Change the geometry representation at the boundary.](https://loaders.gl/next/docs/developer-guide/converters/feature-collection-converters.md): Convert feature collections and single geometries between object, flat, binary, and wire-format shapes.
- [Name the shape before you choose the converter.](https://loaders.gl/next/docs/developer-guide/converters/format-categories.md): Understand the table, geometry, and feature shapes that connect loaders, converters, and renderers.
- [Change the geometry encoding without changing the table contract.](https://loaders.gl/next/docs/developer-guide/converters/geoarrow-converters.md): Move between GeoArrow table shapes and geometry encodings without losing spatial metadata.
- [Move geometry from columns to pixels.](https://loaders.gl/next/docs/developer-guide/converters/render-converters.md): Turn geometry columns and values into render-ready binary feature collections without a GeoJSON detour.
- [Keep the table shape explicit as data moves.](https://loaders.gl/next/docs/developer-guide/converters/table-and-arrow-converters.md): Move between loaders.gl table wrappers, raw Arrow tables, and GeoArrow-compatible data.

#### tile-matrices

A tile matrix describes a rectangular grid at one resolution. A tile matrix set groups these grids in one coordinate reference system (CRS). A tile source combines that geometry with a way to retrieve tile content.

- [Tile matrices and tile matrix sets](https://loaders.gl/next/docs/developer-guide/tile-matrices.md): A tile matrix describes a rectangular grid at one resolution. A tile matrix set groups these grids in one coordinate reference system (CRS). A tile source combines that geometry with a way to retrieve tile content.

### modules


#### arcgis

Connect your existing ArcGIS Online and Enterprise layers to JavaScript applications.

- [@loaders.gl/arcgis](https://loaders.gl/next/docs/modules/arcgis.md): Connect your existing ArcGIS Online and Enterprise layers to JavaScript applications.
- [ArcGIS service sources](https://loaders.gl/next/docs/modules/arcgis/api-reference/arcgis.md): The loaders.gl source contracts for ArcGIS feature, image, vector-tile, and scene services.
- [ArcGIS FeatureServer](https://loaders.gl/next/docs/modules/arcgis/arcgis-feature-server.md): Query ArcGIS feature layers through the loaders.gl vector source contract.
- [ArcGIS ImageServer](https://loaders.gl/next/docs/modules/arcgis/arcgis-image-server.md): Access rendered imagery and analytical raster data through ArcGIS ImageServer.
- [ArcGIS MapServer](https://loaders.gl/next/docs/modules/arcgis/arcgis-map-server.md): Load cached or dynamically rendered ArcGIS map tiles through one tile source.
- [ArcGIS SceneServer](https://loaders.gl/next/docs/modules/arcgis/arcgis-scene-server.md): Connect ArcGIS SceneServer layers to I3S and 3D tileset sources.
- [ArcGIS VectorTileServer](https://loaders.gl/next/docs/modules/arcgis/arcgis-vector-tile-server.md): Load ArcGIS vector tiles, style metadata, and tile grids through a vector-tile source.
- [ArcGIS FeatureServer protocol and formats](https://loaders.gl/next/docs/modules/arcgis/formats/arcgis-feature-server.md): Read your published feature layers and tables as bounded queries with explicit completeness.
- [ArcGIS ImageServer protocol and formats](https://loaders.gl/next/docs/modules/arcgis/formats/arcgis-image-server.md): Choose rendered imagery or numerical pixels from your existing imagery service.
- [ArcGIS MapServer protocol and formats](https://loaders.gl/next/docs/modules/arcgis/formats/arcgis-map-server.md): Display your published map through cached image tiles or dynamic map exports.
- [ArcGIS SceneServer protocol and formats](https://loaders.gl/next/docs/modules/arcgis/formats/arcgis-scene-server.md): Connect an existing scene layer to the appropriate I3S content and rendering path.
- [ArcGIS VectorTileServer protocol and formats](https://loaders.gl/next/docs/modules/arcgis/formats/arcgis-vector-tile-server.md): Read your published vector tiles and style their decoded features in your application.
- [ArcGIS service support](https://loaders.gl/next/docs/modules/arcgis/services.md): Operation-level support and gaps across ArcGIS data, location, analysis and enterprise services.

#### archives

@loaders.gl/archives provides ZIP and TAR archive loaders and writers. Install @loaders.gl/core and @loaders.gl/archives. The root exports metadata loaders and writers; import format-specific helpers from @loaders.gl/archives/zip or @loaders.gl/archives/tar.

- [Archives](https://loaders.gl/next/docs/modules/archives.md): @loaders.gl/archives provides ZIP and TAR archive loaders and writers. Install @loaders.gl/core and @loaders.gl/archives. The root exports metadata loaders and writers; import format-specific helpers from @loaders.gl/archives/zip or @loaders.gl/archives/tar.
- [TAR](https://loaders.gl/next/docs/modules/archives/tar.md): @loaders.gl/archives/tar exports TarLoader, TarWriter, TarBuilder, and readTarArchive. Import TarLoaderWithParser from @loaders.gl/archives/tar/tar-loader for synchronous parser access; the metadata loader loads it through preload().
- [Open archives at the edge of your data pipeline.](https://loaders.gl/next/docs/modules/archives/zip.md): Read and write ZIP archives with loaders.gl.
- [encodeZip](https://loaders.gl/next/docs/modules/archives/zip/api-reference/encode-zip.md): encodeZip(files, options) writes a native ZIP32/ZIP64 archive and returns an ArrayBuffer.
- [ZipArchive](https://loaders.gl/next/docs/modules/archives/zip/api-reference/zip-archive.md): openZipArchive() opens an owned random-access ZIP32/ZIP64 archive. Inputs can be an ArrayBuffer,
- [ZipFileSystem](https://loaders.gl/next/docs/modules/archives/zip/api-reference/zip-filesystem.md): ZipFileSystem adapts the shared ZIP32/ZIP64 reader to the loaders.gl FileSystem interface.
- [Open an archive into named resources.](https://loaders.gl/next/docs/modules/archives/zip/api-reference/zip-loader.md): Decode a ZIP archive into a file map of paths and contents.
- [Package named resources into one archive.](https://loaders.gl/next/docs/modules/archives/zip/api-reference/zip-writer.md): Encode a loaders.gl file map as a ZIP archive with optional progress reporting.
- [ZIP](https://loaders.gl/next/docs/modules/archives/zip/formats/zip.md): Read ZIP containers and their random-access entries as a virtual file system.

#### compression

Compress and decompress common payloads with runtime-aware codecs.

- [Choose the smallest codec that fits the runtime.](https://loaders.gl/next/docs/modules/compression.md): Compress and decompress common payloads with runtime-aware codecs.
- [Use Brotli without bundling every implementation.](https://loaders.gl/next/docs/modules/compression/api-reference/brotli.md): Compress and decompress Brotli payloads with native-stream probing and lazy fallbacks.
- [Use the runtime’s codec before shipping another one.](https://loaders.gl/next/docs/modules/compression/api-reference/built-in-codecs.md): Use browser-native compression streams when the runtime provides them, with documented fallbacks.
- [Support bzip2 without making it everyone’s dependency.](https://loaders.gl/next/docs/modules/compression/api-reference/bzip2.md): Add asynchronous bzip2 encoding and decoding to loaders.gl format pipelines.
- [Move bytes through the codec that fits.](https://loaders.gl/next/docs/modules/compression/api-reference/compressor-decompressor.md): Use one typed interface for lossless compression and decompression across runtimes.
- [Keep wrapped and raw DEFLATE distinct.](https://loaders.gl/next/docs/modules/compression/api-reference/deflate.md): Handle wrapped and raw DEFLATE payloads with the shared compression interfaces.
- [Use one GZIP pair for reads and writes.](https://loaders.gl/next/docs/modules/compression/api-reference/gzip.md): Compress and decompress GZIP payloads through runtime-aware, library-neutral classes.
- [Handle LZ4 frames, blocks, and legacy payloads.](https://loaders.gl/next/docs/modules/compression/api-reference/lz4.md): Read and write LZ4 frames and raw blocks through the loaders.gl compression APIs.
- [LzoDecompressor API Reference](https://loaders.gl/next/docs/modules/compression/api-reference/lzo.md): LzoDecompressor decodes raw LZO1X blocks through the decoder-only compress-utils 0.10 WASM asset.
- [Keep uncompressed formats on the same pipeline path.](https://loaders.gl/next/docs/modules/compression/api-reference/no-compressor-decompressor.md): Represent an uncompressed payload through the same compressor and decompressor contract.
- [Add compact block compression without changing the pipeline.](https://loaders.gl/next/docs/modules/compression/api-reference/snappy.md): Use Snappy blocks and frames through the shared loaders.gl compression interface.
- [Use XZ and LZMA where the format requires it.](https://loaders.gl/next/docs/modules/compression/api-reference/xz.md): Add asynchronous XZ and LZMA compression to loaders.gl pipelines.
- [Keep the large codec out of the common path.](https://loaders.gl/next/docs/modules/compression/api-reference/zstandard.md): Use Zstandard compression with lazy compress-utils WASM fallbacks.
- [Compare codec paths on the machine that will run them.](https://loaders.gl/next/docs/modules/compression/benchmarks.md): Compare browser compression and decompression paths across native and loaders.gl codec implementations.

#### config

The @loaders.gl/config module provides dependency-free parsers for YAML and TOML configuration

- [Overview](https://loaders.gl/next/docs/modules/config.md): The @loaders.gl/config module provides dependency-free parsers for YAML and TOML configuration
- [TOMLLoader](https://loaders.gl/next/docs/modules/config/api-reference/toml-loader.md): TOMLLoader parses TOML configuration documents into JavaScript objects, arrays, dates, and scalar
- [YAMLLoader](https://loaders.gl/next/docs/modules/config/api-reference/yaml-loader.md): YAMLLoader parses YAML documents into JavaScript objects, arrays, and scalar values. It supports
- [TOML](https://loaders.gl/next/docs/modules/config/formats/toml.md): TOML (Tom's Obvious, Minimal Language) is a configuration file format designed to be easy to read
- [YAML](https://loaders.gl/next/docs/modules/config/formats/yaml.md): YAML is a human-friendly data serialization language commonly used for configuration documents.
